kind: Actual fresh MNN3.2.0 conversions,UUID metadata normalization and strict full-file validation
recognizer_command: MNNConvert -f ONNX --modelFile <private>/meiki-stream.onnx --MNNModel <private>/meiki-stream-int8.mnn --bizCode meiki-vita --weightQuantBits 8; python ports/meiki/normalize_mnn_uuid.py --model recognizer <converted>
normalization: Only the fixed-length Net.mnn_uuid metadata string changes. All tensors/operators/coefficients/layout bytes remain the converter output; expected full-file SHA is validated before writing.
corrupt_model_guard: A private copy with one changed non-UUID byte was rejected; every original byte was preserved.
